newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Goldfields eyes new gold development.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Goldfields eyes new gold development.

text.p: Goldfields Ltd said on Wednesday it was targeting mineable reserves of 500,000 ounces of gold at its Keith-Kilkenny gold joint venture with Plutonic Resources Ltd in Western Australia.

"At the Safari prospect, Goldfields has proved up up inferred resource of about 340,000 ounces of gold. We have demonstrated the potential to expand this," Goldfields managing director, Peter Cassidy told a news conference.
Cassidy said the discovery raised the total resources at the Keith-Kilkenny project to about 620,000 ounces at an average grade of about three grams per tonne (g/t) gold.
